integrity: A complete self-contained proof and standard-library finite verifier are provided; no external independent review or validation is claimed.
limitations: No homotopy or Cohen-Macaulay conclusion is asserted; known finite two-matching-complex facet counts are prior examples, not novelty claims.
The historical literature comparison leaves a risk of unindexed equivalent all-board formulas.
Finite computational checks do not replace the unrestricted combinatorial proof.
title: Maximal induced bipartite subgraphs of rook graphs: an exact facet enumerator and a square-board transition
